question:
Select the option that rectifies the spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The politician __guaranted __that he would create jobs if elected.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"guaranted"** is a misspelling and does not have an English meaning or a Hindi meaning. The correct spelling should be **'guaranteed.**'(गलत वर्तनी)

 
 
• **Example: **The politician **guaranteed** that he would create jobs if elected. (This is incorrect due to misspelling.)
 
 
 
• **"guaranteed"** refers to a formal assurance or promise, especially that certain conditions will be fulfilled. (गारंटी)
 
 
• **Example: **The politician **guaranteed** that he would create jobs if elected.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is '**guaranteed**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **gurranted** (गलत वर्तनी): This is an** incorrect spelling** and does not have any meaning in English or Hindi.

 
 
• **Example:** The politician gurranted that he would create jobs if elected. (**This is incorrect due to misspelling.**)
 
 
 
• **gauaranteed** (गलत वर्तनी): This is an **incorrect spelling** and does not have any meaning in English or Hindi.
 
 
• **Example:** The politician gauaranteed that he would create jobs if elected. (**This is incorrect due to misspelling.**)
 
 
 
• **guarranteed** (गलत वर्तनी): This is an **incorrect spelling** and does not have any meaning in English or Hindi.
 
 
• **Example:** The politician guarranteed that he would create jobs if elected. (**This is incorrect due to misspelling.)**
